<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_2064375_onboar_0.OnboardingTaskGenerator</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Generates onboarding task records for a given new hire sys_id and joining date.</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>OnboardingTaskGenerator</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var OnboardingTaskGenerator = Class.create();

OnboardingTaskGenerator.prototype = {

    initialize: function() {
        this.taskTemplates = [
            { type: 'IT Access', name: 'Provision IT access and email account', group: 'IT Help Desk', offsetDays: -3 },
            { type: 'Hardware', name: 'Allocate laptop and peripherals', group: 'Hardware Support', offsetDays: -2 },
            { type: 'ID Card', name: 'Generate employee ID card', group: 'Admin Support', offsetDays: -1 },
            { type: 'Policy Ack', name: 'Send policy acknowledgment forms', group: 'IT Help Desk', offsetDays: 0 },
            { type: 'Buddy Assignment', name: 'Assign onboarding buddy', group: 'Software Support', offsetDays: -2 },
            { type: 'Week 1 Schedule', name: 'Prepare first-week schedule and orientation', group: 'Infrastructure Support', offsetDays: -1 }
        ];
    },

    generateTasks: function(newHireSysId, joiningDateStr) {
        var created = [];

        for (var i = 0; i < this.taskTemplates.length; i++) {
            var tmpl = this.taskTemplates[i];
            var dueDate = this._calculateDueDate(joiningDateStr, tmpl.offsetDays);

            var groupGR = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group');
            groupGR.addQuery('name', tmpl.group);
            groupGR.setLimit(1);
